title: Israeli authorities raze shops and seize land as settlers burn house and vehicles in West Bank
detail: A feed item published November 4, 2026 reports that Israeli authorities razed shops and seized land in the West Bank while settlers burned a house and vehicles. Only the headline was available; the location, outlet and details should be checked against the full report.

title: Settlers seize 8 Palestinian homes near Jericho as residents flee
detail: A feed item published November 4, 2026 reports Israeli settlers seized eight Palestinian homes in the eastern West Bank near Jericho, with residents reportedly fleeing. Only the headline summary was available; details should be checked against the full report.
